method: a genuine Avito search response captured from a residential session (query «ноутбук», locationId 637640); only the image lists, the geo block and the description text were trimmed for size — every field the parser reads is byte-for-byte as Avito sent it

ground_truth.note: the live js/items payload; the contract test pins: location object -> «Москва» (third item has none and reads None), prices [15500.0, 15990.0, 8700.0] from priceDetailed.value (there is no top-level price key), url from urlPath (every item), posted_at derived from the epoch-ms sortTimeStamp.
